title: Plantation agriculture distribution – Rajasthan exception
subject: Economics
caption: Distribution of plantation agriculture across Indian states, with Rajasthan marked as the non‑prominent state.
altText: A textbook-style map of India on a white background where all states that have significant plantation agriculture are shaded green. Rajasthan is colored orange and marked with a bold X to show it does not have prominent plantation crops. Each state is clearly labelled with its name. A legend in the lower right explains the green shading for plantation states and the orange X for Rajasthan. Small icons of tea, coffee, rubber, and coconut are placed near the states where those crops are grown, providing visual reference.
